definitions.explanation: Formal and polite equivalent of について. Used in business correspondence, official announcements, and respectful speech when introducing the topic under discussion.

examples.japanese: この{件|けん}につきましては、{後日|ごじつ}ご{連絡|れんらく}いたします。
examples.english: Regarding this matter, we will contact you at a later date.

examples.japanese: ご{質問|しつもん}につきましては、お{電話|でんわ}にてお{答|こた}えいたします。
examples.english: Regarding your questions, we will respond by telephone.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{不備|ふび}につきまして、{誠|まこと}に{申|もう}し{訳|わけ}ございません。
examples.english: We sincerely apologize for the inadequacy on this occasion.

notes:
Polite form of について (regarding), formed from につく + ます-form + て. Used in formal written and spoken Japanese, particularly in business and official contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～につきまして(は): regarding ~; as for ~
- ～の{件|けん}につきまして: regarding the matter of ~

REGISTER: Formal/polite; the contracted form につきまして alone is already formal; the version with は (につきましては) is used for even greater emphasis or to set up a longer explanation.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- について: regarding — standard/neutral form
- に{関|かん}して: regarding, concerning — also formal, slightly more emphatic
